description: Climate action with More Trees - read the account credit balance, forest stats, planting projects and CO2 figures, and plant trees for yourself or as gifts.

api.description: Read one account: name, credit balance, forest name and slug

fields.description: The More Trees account code, from Settings > Account Settings. Defaults to the stored account_code.

api.description: Read one virtual forest: branding plus planted, gifted and received tree totals and CO2 captured

fields.description: The forest slug or the account code, from Settings > Account Settings. Defaults to the stored account_code.

fields.type: { trees_planted?: number | null, trees_gifted?: number | null, trees_received?: number | null, co2_captured?: number | null, projects_supported?: number | null } | null

api.description: Calculate the CO2 captured and projects supported for a set of tree counts; plants nothing

fields.description: Tree counts keyed by project tree ID. Project tree IDs are not tree IDs and no API-key route lists them; 26 and 28 are known (probed 11-26).

api.description: List every active planting project with country, supplier and the trees you can plant in it

fields.type: { default?: boolean | null, id?: string | null, name?: string | null, description?: string | null, country?: string | null, project_type?: string | null, supplier_name?: string | null, project_image?: string | null, trees?: { default?: boolean | null, id?: string | null, name?: string | null, description?: string | null, tonnes_co2?: number | null, credits_required?: number | null, tree_image?: string | null, total?: number | null }[] | null }[]

api.description: Plant trees from the payment account for yourself or as gifts; spends credits unless test mode is on

input.type: { payment_account_code?: string, test?: boolean, project_id?: string | number, tree_id?: string | number, plant_for_others: false, quantity: number } | { payment_account_code?: string, test?: boolean, project_id?: string | number, tree_id?: string | number, plant_for_others: true, recipients: { account_code?: string, email?: string, name: string, quantity: number }[] }

fields.description: A More Trees ID, as a string (IDs can exceed 2^53).
